memory:
User lives in a Harajuku studio for 3 months, has a convenient commute, and explores hidden gems/new neighborhoods. Plans a November Japanese Alps trip, may invite Tokyo friends, staying in Matsumoto (chosen over Hakuba) for culture/history. Wants Meiji/Kawai Shrine info. Planning Yokohama: Minato M

REMINDERS (from a consistency check against the session):
- “Harajuku studio” is unsupported; R says the user lives in Harajuku, without specifying a studio.
- The user enjoys Tokyo’s fall foliage, especially colors different from those familiar from home; S omits this preference.
- The user explores a new neighborhood every Sunday and visited a Daikanyama coffee shop last weekend; S omits both facts.
- The Yokohama plan includes Minato Mirai 21, Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse, and possibly Yokohama Central Market for grilled squid; S reduces this to unclear “Minato M.”
- The user plans to eat kanimeshi at Kanemasa and namashirasu at Tsukiji Itadori Uogashi Nihon-Ichi; S omits these plans.
- The user may attend Yokohama’s Oktoberfest, Autumn Leaves Festival, and Minato Mirai 21 illuminations depending on dates; S omits these events.
- The several-day November Nagano/Matsumoto trip includes the Japanese Alps Visitor Center, Matsumoto Castle, Nawate Street, the Matsumoto Folkcraft Museum, and Zenko-ji if time permits; S largely omits the itinerary.
- The user intends to visit Meiji Shrine and Kawai Shrine and chose Matsumoto over Hakuba, prioritizing Matsumoto Castle over Zenko-ji; S weakens these as wanting information and an unexplained choice.
